brief.prompt:
INITIAL GENERATION PROMPT:
Use case: ads-marketing, editorial sports illustration.
Create ONE final Japanese basketball article thumbnail by redesigning the supplied approved style-reference poster. Landscape 16:9, target 1792x1024 or 1672x941, at least 1000 px wide. Opaque PNG.

Reference image 1 is ONLY the approved visual style: near-black #151A18, electric lime #CCF43B, cream white, huge bold Japanese type, hand-painted ink and brush sports illustration. Replace all its previous words, numbers and player; never carry over Culver, Sendai, Kobe or 38.
Reference image 2 is the official face/appearance reference for the ONLY player to draw, real basketball player Matt Bonds (マット・ボンズ). Use it only to study his face and hair. Do not paste any photographic pixels into the design. His distinctive medium-length thick free-form black dreadlocks radiate outward, forehead and arched brows visible, oval face tapering to the chin, broad nose, full lips, short mustache and pointed dark chin beard connected along the jaw, warm deep-brown skin, powerful muscular shoulders. Preserve these recognizable facial features in expressive hand-drawn pen-and-brush illustration with readable eyes/nose/mouth and lit facial planes. He must not look like the man in reference 1 or an invented generic player.

Composition: Novel left-player / right-type composition. On the LEFT 42 percent, Matt Bonds is in a dynamic forward-driving basketball stance, torso bent and twisting slightly, face in clear three-quarter view looking ahead, cradling a complete orange basketball with both hands at lower chest/waist while changing direction. Ball fully within the canvas and naturally grasped; coherent wrists and five fingers on each visible hand. Show head, shoulders, arms, hands, ball, upper legs. Body may naturally extend through lower edge but do not cut head, hair, hands, ball. Plain burgundy basketball jersey with simple cream trim, plain shorts. NO jersey names, numbers, team badges, sponsors, league logos, manufacturer marks. Bold cream ink contours and sparse burgundy shading; lime motion brush strokes behind him. No second person, no crowd, no trophy, no realistic arena, no actual game reenactment. This is a conceptual PLAY illustration, never a documented moment or winning-shot depiction.
On the RIGHT 56 percent, typography has clean negative space. Very large headline with strongest hierarchy on '2連勝'. All text is horizontal Japanese, accurately legible, bold and carefully spaced. Dark background throughout, enough contrast, minimal decorative elements. At least 50 px safe margins for all lettering, head, hands, ball. No overlapping face/text.
Only these text strings appear, verbatim:
Small masthead at top: 「バスケまとめ」
Upper right eyebrow: 「神奈川ダービー」
Large right headline line 1 in cream: 「横浜BC」
Largest right headline line 2 in electric lime, dynamic brush numerals: 「2連勝」
Lower right compact score block, two lines: 「第2戦」 and 「横浜BC 77–66 川崎」
Bottom footer, clearly legible cream Japanese: 「イラスト（AI生成）｜イメージ」

Editorial truth: All headline/score facts come exclusively from the supplied frozen article: Yokohama BC won both October 31 and November 1; the second-game score was Yokohama BC 77, Kawasaki 66. The article focuses on the teams, so Matt Bonds is selected as the only named player in the article under the requested random-selection rule. Do not put his name in the artwork. Do not claim his individual statistics, his appearance in either game, or his contribution to Yokohama's wins. No individual points, no season records, no head-to-head records, no rankings: those are unverified or independently calculated in the article and are intentionally omitted. The figure represents a conceptual image of the named real player, not evidence of any game moment. Keep the AI label and the word イメージ exactly as specified.
Make this a polished, bold, sparse, hand-illustrated sports thumbnail consistent with approved ink/brush style, not photorealistic, not a photo collage, not 3D. Output exactly one image.

ONE ALLOWED CORRECTION PROMPT:
Edit this supplied thumbnail with ONE targeted layout correction only. Preserve ALL existing Japanese typography, exact words and scores, their locations, the near-black/lime palette, brush texture, Matt Bonds's facial likeness, dreadlocks, beard, burgundy logo-free uniform, dynamic ball-carrying pose, natural hand anatomy, and the visible AI/image footer.
The man's dreadlocks currently touch and clip the TOP border, and his far-left hand almost touches the LEFT border. Scale the entire illustrated PLAYER PLUS BALL uniformly to about 88% of its current size within the left panel, and move it slightly down and right so that every hair tip has at least 45 pixels of dark background above it, and all fingers and the ball have at least 45 pixels of breathing room from the left edge. Keep the player dominant and face clearly visible. Upper legs can still extend through the lower edge. Rebuild just the uncovered background as the same dark-and-lime brush texture. Do not add characters or logos. Do not change the face, pose, hair silhouette, hands, score, captions, or typography. Keep landscape approximately 16:9 at least 1000px width. All text remains:
バスケまとめ
神奈川ダービー
横浜BC
2連勝
第2戦
横浜BC 77–66 川崎
イラスト（AI生成）｜イメージ
Output one corrected PNG. This is a concept illustration of real Matt Bonds, not a reenactment or a claim of his game appearance/statistics.
